name: transcription-pipeline
description: One transcription pipeline in stages: collect a recording (local, Google Drive, S3, URL), prepare it (EQ, denoise, silence trim, downsample), transcribe it (OpenRouter/Gemini Flash, AssemblyAI, Gemini, or a local Whisper/Parakeet server), clean it (light or heavy), label speakers, reshape it (spec, minutes, to-do, blog, or any of 206 bundled text-transformation prompts), typeset it (Typst PDF) and save every artefact. Several recordings run concurrently, one worker per file. User preferences live in a plain file, not in the plugin.
